title: DesignRegister
description: Metaphor→Mechanism program (prophet-platform docs/METAPHOR_TO_MECHANISM_PROGRAM.md). A design register is the machine-checkable ledger of design concepts: every entry carries a status on the execution ladder and a probe that can prove it. INVARIANT DR-I1 (the ladder rule): no entry may be described — in code comments, memory, retrospectives, or external communications — above its probe-verified status. INVARIANT DR-I2: any entry claiming status `wired` or above MUST carry a runnable `probe_cmd`, and a failing probe is a build failure, not a warning (enforced structurally below via if/then). The register exists to make an unimplemented design a red CI gate instead of an archaeology finding.

id.description: Stable kebab-case slug; the concept's greppable name from this point on.

source.description: Where the design was authored (diagram, doc, audit) — the artifact this entry keeps honest.

mechanism.description: The concept re-expressed as a mechanism over EXISTING capabilities. Metaphor is not a mechanism; if this field cannot be written concretely, the entry is not ready to leave `absent`.

owner.description: Owning repo/service(s) — where the mechanism lives or will live.

status.description: The execution ladder. absent: idea only. declared: spec/schema merged. wired: callers > 0, deployed, live probe passes. measured: a metric/bench number exists. sealed: the number is receipted/replay-exact.

probe.description: Human-readable statement of what would prove the current status claim.

probe_cmd.description: Runnable shell probe (file/grep/curl-grade, cheap by construction). Exit 0 = claim holds. Required at `wired` and above (DR-I2).

notes.description: Optional context: research gates, sequencing rationale, prior convictions.
